note: canvas_full_html swaps Drupal Canvas's restricted rich-text formats (canvas_html_block, canvas_html_inline) for a dedicated canvas_full_html text format inside Canvas WYSIWYG props. Its only stored config is the boolean canvas_full_html.settings:enabled (default true); the admin form is route canvas_full_html.settings at /admin/config/content/canvas-full-html (permission administer site configuration). On install it ships filter.format.canvas_full_html, editor.editor.canvas_full_html (a CKEditor5 config) and canvas_full_html.settings. All logic is in the autowired hook service Drupal\canvas_full_html\Hook\CanvasFullHtmlHooks (hook_canvas_storable_prop_shape_alter swaps the format for text/html props; hook_library_info_alter attaches canvas_full_html/ckeditor-fixes to canvas/canvas-ui). Medium/hard cases only read/write config (drush cget/cset and config-factory saves) and never trigger a full cache rebuild, because on THIS shared site canvas core and ui_patterns both register a component plugin manager and 'drush cr' fatals in canvas's component rebuild hook (a pre-existing collision, unrelated to this module). All facts grounded in src/, config/install and config/schema.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal contrib module canvas_full_html. How do I turn its Full HTML replacement off without uninstalling? Which config object and key controls it, and is there an admin page?
evals.expected_output: Set canvas_full_html.settings:enabled to false (drush cset canvas_full_html.settings enabled 0). There is an admin form at /admin/config/content/canvas-full-html (route canvas_full_html.settings, permission 'administer site configuration') with an 'Enable Full HTML format in Canvas' checkbox. Default is true.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal canvas_full_html module actually change in Canvas, and which text formats are involved? Which hook does it use?
evals.expected_output: When enabled it replaces Canvas's restricted text formats (canvas_html_block, canvas_html_inline) with the dedicated canvas_full_html format for component props whose schema is contentMediaType: text/html. It does this in hook_canvas_storable_prop_shape_alter() (Drupal\canvas_full_html\Hook\CanvasFullHtmlHooks).

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal canvas_full_html module, how do I customise which CKEditor 5 buttons appear in the Canvas editor, and will that affect my site's other text formats?
evals.expected_output: Edit the dedicated canvas_full_html text format at /admin/config/content/formats/manage/canvas_full_html (editor.editor.canvas_full_html). It is a normal CKEditor 5 config; changes affect only Canvas editors, not full_html or any other format. Both core and contrib CKEditor 5 plugins are supported.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, is the canvas_full_html Full HTML replacement currently switched on or off? Inspect the live configuration and report the exact config object, key and its current value.
evals.expected_output: It is currently OFF: canvas_full_html.settings:enabled = false. Discoverable with: drush cget canvas_full_html.settings enabled (or drush php:eval to read \Drupal::config('canvas_full_html.settings')->get('enabled')).

evals.prompt: The canvas_full_html module ships its own CKEditor 5 editor for the canvas_full_html text format. On this live site, inspect that editor's configuration and tell me whether the toolbar includes a 'Source editing' (sourceEditing) button.
evals.expected_output: Yes. editor.editor.canvas_full_html's toolbar items include sourceEditing (alongside heading, bold, italic, underline, link, lists, blockQuote, horizontalLine, etc.). Discoverable with: drush php:eval "print_r(\Drupal::config('editor.editor.canvas_full_html')->get('settings.toolbar.items'));".

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, disable the canvas_full_html Full HTML replacement so Canvas falls back to its own restricted formats, WITHOUT uninstalling the module. Make the change to the module's configuration.
evals.expected_output: canvas_full_html.settings:enabled is set to false, e.g. drush cset canvas_full_html.settings enabled 0 -y.

evals.prompt: Add the inline 'code' button (CKEditor 5 toolbar item 'code') to the canvas_full_html text format's editor toolbar on this site, so Canvas editors can mark inline code. Modify the editor.editor.canvas_full_html configuration.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.canvas_full_html settings.toolbar.items now contains 'code' (appended to the existing items).
